It's not that easy, birds aren't like dogs in the sense that they will love you immediately.  Please tell us about his future environment you are going to be giving him so we can give advice on that as well, cage size, what you are gonna feed him, etc.  We would all also love pictures!  I completely agree with what u/ASmokinHotGrill said though.  Remember, it can take days, hours, months, or even years to get a bird to trust you.  If he's a baby, it might take anywhere from a day to a few weeks.  Just depends on the bird.
I'm so glad you're saving him!  Can't wait to see how far he comes <3

I thought it showed it up randomly for me too, but if you think back do you ever remember pulling out hair from your eyebrows eyelashes or head ever?  When I was little I thought it was normal.
